UniversityWestern346 — Business vs Enterprise for managing multiple clients
I am a designer who is working with a marketing agency and I’ve been tasked with figuring out which Canva type is right for us. We have about 5 clients that we manage with more on the way. We want to set up brand kits for each (which I know how to do) and share those brand kits and accompanying designs with those clients. So client A only has access to Client A’s kits/templates, etc.
My question here is what is the best way to do this? Do we buy a Business account and add each client as a team member but only grant them access to certain templates? We’re thinking we’ll have to do this and build their Canva account price into their billing but I just want to make sure I’m understanding this process correctly and Canva has no way of contacting anyone to ask actual questions.
